$comment: TF-C66 (D-FFI-SHIPPED-LIBS-OS-ONLY): the C99 <inttypes.h> PRI* format-length macros ship as an OS descriptor (inttypes.json), added need-driven because the sqlite full-source testfixture uses PRIi64/PRIu32/PRIi32/PRIu64. Each expands to a quoted string fragment; a 64-bit specifier carries the `l` length modifier (glibc `l`, Apple/Windows `ll` -- both begin `l`), a 32-bit one does not. The program checks that width-class property (portable across formats) -> exit 42. RED-ON-DISABLE: delete inttypes.json -> `#include <inttypes.h>` fails F001A (no binary); or blank a macro replacement -> the specifier loses its `l` and returns 1/5. The release arm proves the preprocessor-materialized macro text survives the optimizer end-to-end.
